blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Learnable downsampling and spectral-domain filter parameterizations have each made convolutional networks more flexible, but their interaction has not been systematically examined. We bridge this gap by examining convolutional kernels learned in the spatial and spectral domains, together with learned downsampling ratios under a cropped resizing implementation. We find that spectral and spatial kernels respond differently to learned resolution allocation, with larger gains for the spectral kernel. We observe this consistently on three datasets (EuroSAT, CIFAR-10 and STL-10) and at two model sizes (differences in accuracy gain of +0.013 to +0.028 on held-out test sets). Part of this difference reflects the greater gain of the spectral kernel from retaining more spatial area, but the difference remains positive when total retained area is matched. This pattern is observed across datasets and model sizes, although its magnitude and dependence on the complexity budget vary with model size and the resizing implementation.
blocks.zh: 可学习的下采样和光谱域滤波参数化,使演化网络更加灵活,但它们的相互作用并没有被系统审查. 我们通过审查在空间和光谱领域学到的内核,以及根据裁剪后的重新定型执行所学到的下采样比率,来弥补这一差距。 我们发现光谱和空间内核对所学到的分辨率分配的反应不同,光谱内核的增益更大. 我们从三个数据集(EuroSAT、CIFAR-10和STL-10)和两个模型大小(在停机试验中精度增益+0.013至+0.028)上一致观察到这一点。 这一差异的一部分反映了光谱内核从保留更多空间面积中获得更大的收益,但当总保留面积匹配时,差异仍然是正数. 这种模式在数据集和模型规模中都有所观察到,尽管其规模和对复杂预算的依赖程度因模型规模和重新确定实施规模而异。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In convolutional networks, spatial resolution is usually fixed by architectural choices such as strides, pooling windows and resizing ratios. Recent work makes it learnable: DiffStride [ 10 ] learns strides through differentiable cropping in the Fourier domain, Resolution Layers [ 2 ] extend this to both downsampling and upsampling without tying it to a particular transform, and DNArch [ 14 ] learns downsampling jointly with continuous kernels generated by an MLP. These methods are evaluated mainly by predictive performance, not by how learned resolution interacts with the way the filters are parameterized.
blocks.zh: 在演化网络中,空间分辨率通常由走进,集合窗口和再大小比例等建筑选择所固定. 最近的工作使它可以学习: DiffStride [10] 通过Fourier域的可分化的收割来学习脚步,分辨率层 [2] 扩展到下采样和上采样两种,而不将其与特定的变换捆绑在一起,DNArch [14] 与由 MLP 产生的连续内核一起学习下采样. 这些方法主要通过预测性能来评价,而不是通过所学得的分辨率如何与过滤器的参数化方式相互作用来评价.

blocks.en: A separate line of work learns convolutional filters in the spectral domain [ 12 , 9 , 16 , 3 ] , which gives control over the spatial extent of the filtering operation. DNArch [ 14 ] conjectures that generated kernels may be easier to construct at lower resolutions, suggesting an interaction between kernel parameterization and resolution allocation, but this has not been tested.
blocks.zh: 单独的一行工作在光谱域中学习了分解滤波器[12,9,16,3],这使得滤波操作的空间范围得到控制. 生成内核的DNA [14] 猜想在更低的分辨率下可能更容易被构建出,暗示了内核参数化和分辨率分配之间的相互作用,但这还没有经过测试.

blocks.en: To examine how these methods interact, we combine learnable resizing [ 2 ] with either 3 × 3 3\times 3 spatial kernels or spectral kernels generated by a coordinate-based MLP [ 3 ] , while controlling the cutoff-frequency budget and, in our main comparison, approximately matching retained feature-map area between kernel types. Our results establish three observations. First, spectral and spatial kernels respond differently to learned resolution allocation: spectral kernels obtain significantly larger gains than spatial kernels. This difference is observed across three datasets and two model sizes. The difference remains when the comparison is made against a fixed schedule with the same total retained area, although the effect is smaller. Second, the magnitude of this difference decreases as model size increases, under both the soft and the cropped implementations. Third, the magnitude of the effect depends on how resizing is implemented: a full-resolution soft-masking approach produces a larger benefit (but requires substantially more computation), whereas the cropped implementation produces a smaller (but measurable) effect. These results suggest that spatial resolution cannot be treated independently of filter parameterization.
blocks.zh: 为了检查这些方法的相互作用,我们把可学习的再大小[2]与由坐标基的MLP[3]生成的3个空间内核或光谱内核相结合,同时控制断频预算,并在我们的主要比较中,大致匹配内核类型之间保留的地物图区域. 我们的结果确立了三项看法。 第一,光谱和空间内核对所学到的分辨率分配的反应不同:光谱内核获得的增益明显大于空间内核. 这一差异在三个数据集和两个模型大小之间观察到. 在与同一总保留面积的固定时间表进行比较时,差异依然存在,尽管效果较小。 第二,这种差异的程度随着模型尺寸的增加而减少,在软性执行和收成执行中都是如此。 第三,影响的程度取决于如何实施再分配:一个全分辨率的软装方法产生更大的好处(但需要大量计算),而被裁剪的执行则产生较小的(但可衡量的)效果。 这些结果表明空间分辨率不能独立于过滤参数化处理.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: This work builds on learnable downsampling and learnable kernel sizes. DiffStride [ 10 ] learns fractional strides by cropping the Fourier spectrum under a smooth adaptive-span mask, while Resolution Layers [ 2 ] extend learnable resizing to downsampling, upsampling, and other transforms. Shape Adaptor [ 8 ] and DynOPool [ 5 ] learn task-dependent feature-map scale factors, the latter under a complexity constraint. These methods optimize resolution or scale but do not study its interaction with filter parameterization.
blocks.zh: 这项工作以可学习的下取样和可学习的内核尺寸为基础。 DiffStride [10]通过在平滑的适应-平面口罩下收割傅里叶光谱来学习分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分分 形状适配器 [8]和 DynOPool [5] 学习任务依赖的特征-映射尺度因子,后者受到复杂性制约. 这些方法优化了分辨率或尺度,但不研究其与过滤参数化的相互作用.

blocks.en: DNArch [ 14 ] learns frequency-domain downsampling jointly with MLP-generated kernels and conjectures that such kernels are easier to construct at lower resolutions, but does not test whether filter parameterization changes the benefit of learned resolution. We instantiate truncation as in Resolution Layers, soft masking as in DNArch, and ramp cropping as in DiffStride in one backbone (Sec. 3.2). Downsampling can introduce aliasing [ 11 ] , while differentiable discrete choices follow the broader DARTS framework [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: DNArch [14] 与 MLP 生成的内核共同学习了频率-域下取样和猜想,认为这种内核在下分辨率下更容易构造,但并不测试过滤参数化是否改变所学解析度的好处. 我们像分辨率层那样即时断接,像DNA那样软地遮掩,像DiffStride一样在一根骨干中斜坡收割(第3.2节)。 下采样可以引入别名 [11],而不同的离散选择则遵循更广泛的DARTS框架 [7].

blocks.en: 3.3 Spectral Kernels
blocks.zh: 3.3 光谱内核

blocks.en: The spatial kernel is a standard 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution. The spectral kernel, SpecMLP, generates the kernel directly in the frequency domain, similar to [ 3 ] : each normalized frequency coordinate ( u , v ) (u,v) is passed through a two-layer MLP (hidden width 64) that outputs C in × C out × 2 C_{\mathrm{in}}\times C_{\mathrm{out}}\times 2 values, the real and imaginary parts of the kernel at that frequency, which multiply the real FFT of the input before an inverse transform. SpecMLP is thus the frequency-domain analogue of CKConv [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 空间内核是一个标准 3× 3 3\times 3 演化. 光谱内核SpecMLP直接生成频率域中的内核,类似于[3]:每个正态频率坐标(u, v (u,v))通过一个双层的MLP(隐藏宽度64)传递,在X C出X 2 CXMThrm{in}}\tims CXMThrm{out}}\tims 2值,该频率的内核的真假部分,在逆变前将输入的真FFT相乘. SpecMLP因此是CKConv [13] 的频率域模拟.

blocks.en: The backbone has a stem convolution followed by four stages, and the kernel under study replaces the convolution in the first stage. We use F = 16 F=16 channels for the spatial kernel and F = 8 F=8 for SpecMLP ( 20,974 20{,}974 and 24,790 24{,}790 parameters); Sec. 4.3 controls for width and parameter count, and Sec. 4.4 scales both models.
blocks.zh: 骨干有干子演化后有四个阶段,所研究的内核在第一阶段取代了接生. 我们使用F=16 F=16通道进行空间内核,F=8 F=8用于SpecMLP(20,974 20{,}974和24,790 24{,}790个参数);Sec.4.3控制宽度和参数计数,Sec.4.4两个模型.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: We use EuroSAT RGB [ 4 ] , CIFAR-10 [ 6 ] , and STL-10 [ 1 ] . For EuroSAT, the public 60/20/20 split is used, with its 16,200-image training partition further split 80/20 into 12,960 training and 3,240 validation images; the 5,400 test images remain held out. For CIFAR-10, 12,960 class-balanced images from the official training split are used for training, while the official test split is partitioned into 3,240 validation and 6,760 held-out test images. The 13,000 labeled STL-10 images are split class-balanced into 10,000/1,500/1,500 training/validation/test images.
blocks.zh: 我们使用EuroSAT RGB [4],CIFAR-10 [6],和STL-10 [1]. 对于EuroSAT,则使用公用620/20分机,其16,200-图像训练分机进一步将80/20分机分为12,960分机培训和3,240分机验证图像;5,400分机测试图像仍被保留. 对于CIFAR-10,官方训练分机的12,960个班级平衡图像用于训练,而官方测试分机则被分出为3,240个验证和6,760个停放测试图像. 标有"STL-10"的13000幅图象被分班平衡为10000/1500/1500的训练/验证/测试图象.

blocks.en: We first compare the accuracy gains for downsampling with spatial and spectral kernels. Table 1 and Fig. 1 report the accuracy gain from learnable S S under crop resizing. In all four settings, the spectral kernel gains more than the spatial one: the Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} is +0.013 to +0.028 on the test sets ( p ≤ 0.02 p\leq 0.02 ) and +0.020 to +0.025 on validation. The spatial kernel gains little ( − 0.007 -0.007 to +0.009), whereas the spectral kernel gains +0.011 to +0.031.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将下采样的精度收益与空间和光谱内核进行比较. 表1和图1报告作物再生规模下可学习的SS的精度收益。 在所有四个设置中,光谱内核的增益大于空间内核:在测试集上,QQ的增益为+0.013至+0.028 (p 0.02 p\leq 0.02),在验证上为+0.020至+0.025. 空间内核的增收很少(-0.007-0.007至+.009),而光谱内核的增收为+0.011至+0.031.

blocks.en: Because crop retains about 0.24 of the feature-map area, roughly twice the 0.12 of the fixed schedule, we also compare against a fixed schedule with matched retained area ( p ⋆ = 0.25 p^{\star}=0.25 ). Increasing the fixed schedule to this area without learning gives a Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} of + 0.007 +0.007 to + 0.018 +0.018 on validation, significant on EuroSAT and STL-10, showing that part of its gain under crop comes from retaining more spatial area. However, relative to this matched-area baseline, learned allocation still produces a larger gain for the spectral kernel in every setting ( Δ gain = + 0.006 \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}}=+0.006 to +0.015), significant in two of four cases (Table 2).
blocks.zh: 由于作物保留了约0.24个地貌图面积,大约是固定时间表0.12的两倍,因此我们也比较了固定时间表中相应的保留面积(p = 0.25 p = star = 0.25)。 在不学习的情况下增加这个领域的固定时间表,在验证时得到+0.007+0.007到+0.018+0.018的QQ收益,这对EuroSAT和STL-10具有重大意义,表明其在作物下的部分收益来自保留了更多的空间面积. 然而,与这一匹配区域基线相比,学到的分拨仍能为每个环境的光谱内核带来更大的收益(QQ增益=+ 0.06\Delta_{\-mathrm{gain}}=+-0.006-+0.015),在四种情况中,有两种是显著的(表2)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Effect of the Resizing Implementation
blocks.zh: 4.2 调整执行规模的效果

blocks.en: The Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} depends on how resizing is implemented (Table 1 ). Soft gives the largest values ( + 0.020 +0.020 to + 0.049 +0.049 ) at about 6.5 × 6.5\times the FLOPs of fixed , and on CIFAR-10 and STL-10 much of this comes from it lowering the spatial kernel ( − 0.050 -0.050 , − 0.037 -0.037 ) rather than from spectral gains. The tighter ramp crop ( s l + 4 s_{l}+4 ) yields smaller Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} , significant only for EuroSAT with the larger models. A CIFAR-10 threshold sweep gives Δ gain = + 0.012 , + 0.018 , + 0.019 \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}}=+0.012,+0.018,+0.019 for ϵ = 0.1 , 0.01 , 0.001 \epsilon=0.1,0.01,0.001 , respectively, suggesting saturation once sufficient spectrum above the cutoff is retained. We use ϵ = 0.01 \epsilon=0.01 for the main crop comparison.

blocks.en: The remaining rows of Table 2 rule out simpler explanations. Narrowing the spatial baseline or matching its parameter count leaves Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} unchanged. Training CIFAR-10 at its native resolution, which avoids the empty spectrum introduced by upsampling, gives the same result as the upsampled version. Training CIFAR-10 for 100 epochs raises fixed-schedule test accuracy by about 0.06 0.06 and retains a significant test-set Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} of +0.014 ( n = 10 n=10 , p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ), versus +0.018 at 30 epochs. A CKConv-style kernel generated by a SIREN [ 15 ] over spatial offsets gains + 0.014 +0.014 from learnable S S , between the 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernel ( + 0.007 +0.007 ) and SpecMLP ( + 0.027 +0.027 ); the ordering is significant on validation but not on test. Finally, imposing without learning a fixed schedule with the high first-stage ratio that the spectral filters learn ( s 1 / s 2 = 2.06 s_{1}/s_{2}=2.06 , at the area of fixed) improves the spectral kernel by +0.018 and the spatial kernel by +0.004 ( n = 30 n=30 ), a Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} of +0.014 ( p = 0.0003 p=0.0003 ), similar in size to that of crop for these models (+0.013). On EuroSAT, imposing the allocation that the spectral filters learn thus reproduces a Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} of similar size without learning.

blocks.en: On EuroSAT, the spectral filters allocate relatively more resolution to the stage in which they operate: under soft they learn s 1 / s 2 = 2.09 ± 0.54 s_{1}/s_{2}=2.09\pm 0.54 against 1.34 ± 0.11 1.34\pm 0.11 for spatial filters ( p = 4 × 10 − 4 p=4\times 10^{-4} ), and moving the spectral kernel to the second stage shifts the allocation preference accordingly (Fig. 3 (a)). The same pattern appears under crop on EuroSAT ( K 1 / K 2 K_{1}/K_{2} of 1.8 1.8 against 1.2 1.2 ) but only weakly on the other datasets, so we report it as a property of the EuroSAT solutions, not a mechanism. The learned filters are compact: the median filter places 83% of its energy within 3 × 3 3\times 3 , and its effective area does not differ between fixed and soft ( p = 0.84 p=0.84 ; Fig. 3 (b)). With the larger EuroSAT models, the qualitative pattern is robust to initialization: under crop , initializing S S at 1.0 × 1.0\times , 1.3 × 1.3\times , or 1.6 × 1.6\times the fixed schedule yields test-set Δ gain = + 0.021 , + 0.016 , + 0.015 \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}}=+0.021,+0.016,+0.015 , respectively, while preserving a larger learned first-to-second-stage cutoff ratio for spectral filters.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We studied how learnable resizing interacts with convolutional filter parameterization. Under matched cutoff-frequency budgets, spectral and 3 × 3 3\times 3 spatial filters respond differently to learned resolution allocation, with larger gains for spectral filters across three datasets and two model sizes. The effect weakens with model size and depends on the resizing implementation. The effect is modest and largest for small models under tight budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了可学习的再大小如何与演化过滤参数化相互作用。 在相匹配的截断频率预算下,光谱和3×3相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这种效应会随着模型的大小而减弱,并取决于重定执行的大小. 在预算紧张的情况下,对小型模型的影响不大,而且最大。

blocks.en: The models remain relatively small despite the scale study, and we test one backbone with a single spectral parameterization in a single layer. Crop retains about twice the area of the fixed schedule, explaining part of the observed gain. The remaining Δ gain \Delta_{\mathrm{gain}} is not fully explained; measuring how spectral filters use frequencies above the cutoff is a natural next step.
blocks.zh: 尽管进行了规模研究,这些模型仍然相对较小,我们测试了单一光谱参数化的一个主干. 作物保留了固定时间表的约两倍面积,解释了观察到的部分收益. 剩下的 \ Delta\ mathrm{ gain} 未充分解释; 测量光谱过滤器如何使用超过截取的频率是自然的下一步 。
